disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of general duty, consisting of negligence or failure to exercise due care, including negligent delegation or supervision, whether or not injury results.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a violation of general duty, consisting of negligence or failure to exercise due care, including negligent delegation to or supervision of employees or other individuals, whether or not injury results
Personal disqualifications, consisting of 1 or more of the following: (i) Incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Substance use disorder that may impair ability to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Subject to sections 16165 to 16170a, substance use disorder as that term is defined in section 100d of the mental health code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical inability reasonably related to and adversely affecting ability to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical inability reasonably related to and adversely affecting the licensee's or registrant's ability to practice in a safe and competent manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of certain misdemeanors or felonies.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a misdemeanor punishable by imprisonment for a maximum term of 2 years; conviction of a misdemeanor involving the illegal delivery, possession, or use of a controlled substance; or conviction of any felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or renewing a license or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or renewing a license or registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting a license or registration to be used by an unauthorized person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting a license or registration to be used by an unauthorized person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice outside the scope of a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice outside the scope of a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining, possessing, or attempting to obtain a controlled substance without lawful authority; or selling, prescribing, or administering drugs for other than lawful purposes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining, possessing, or attempting to obtain or possess a controlled substance or a drug as that term is defined in section 7105 without lawful authority; or selling, prescribing, giving away, or administering drugs for other than lawful diagnostic or therapeutic purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing fees for referral of patients or accepting kickbacks on medical or surgical services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing fees for referral of patients or accepting kickbacks on medical or surgical services, appliances, or medications purchased by or in behalf of patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation to a consumer or patient or in obtaining third-party reimbursement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation to a consumer or patient or in obtaining or attempting to obtain third-party reimbursement in the course of professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sexual conduct with a patient while acting within the health profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct by a licensee or registrant with a patient while the licensee or registrant is acting within the health profession...that is sexual or may reasonably be interpreted as sexual

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation of, or aiding or abetting in a violation of, this article or rules promulgated under it.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation, or aiding or abetting in a violation, of this article or of a rule promulgated under this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to notify the department of a criminal conviction or disciplinary action by another state within 30 days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to notify under section 16222(3) or (4).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the terms of a practice agreement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the terms of a practice agreement described in section 17047(2)(a) or (b), 17547(2)(a) or (b), or 18047(2)(a) or (b).

definition_quote.value: The evaluation, diagnosis, management, and prevention of conditions of the lower extremities, including local manifestations of systemic disease in the human foot and ankle, by attending to and advising patients and through the use of devices, diagnostic tests, drugs and biologicals, surgical procedures, or other means.
definition_quote.quote: The evaluation, diagnosis, management, and prevention of conditions of the lower extremities, including local manifestations of systemic disease in the human foot and ankle, by attending to and advising patients and through the use of devices, diagnostic tests, drugs and biologicals, surgical procedures, or other means.

methods_authorized.quote: by attending to and advising patients and through the use of devices, diagnostic tests, drugs and biologicals, surgical procedures, or other means. The evaluation, diagnosis, management, and prevention of conditions of the lower extremities may include osseous and soft tissue procedures that address the pathology of the foot, ankle, and the contiguous attachments below the tibial tuberosity.

drug_authority.value: Podiatric physicians may use drugs and biologicals within their scope of practice
drug_authority.quote: through the use of devices, diagnostic tests, drugs and biologicals, surgical procedures, or other means

amputation_authorized.quote: "Practice of podiatric medicine and podiatric surgery" does not include amputations proximal to the tibiotalar joint

anesthesia_authority.quote: "Practice of podiatric medicine and podiatric surgery" does not include...the administration of intravenous sedation or general anesthesia.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: osseous and soft tissue procedures that address the pathology of the foot, ankle, and the contiguous attachments below the tibial tuberosity

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: including local manifestations of systemic disease in the human foot and ankle

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: A physician's assistant may make calls or go on rounds in private homes, public institutions, emergency vehicles, ambulatory care clinics, hospitals, intermediate or extended care facilities, health maintenance organizations, nursing homes, or other health care facilities in accordance with a practice agreement.

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: A physician's assistant who is a party to a practice agreement may prescribe a drug in accordance with procedures and protocols for the prescription established by rule of the department in consultation with the appropriate board.

telehealth_authorized.quote: a health professional shall not provide a telehealth service without directly or indirectly obtaining consent for treatment

controlled_substances_prescribing_ce_req.quote: the board shall promulgate rules requiring each applicant for license renewal to complete as part of the continuing education requirement of subsection (1) an appropriate number of hours or courses in pain and symptom management

wound_debridement_authorized.quote: The treatment of ulcerations below the tibial tuberosity

physician_assistant_collaboration_author.quote: A physician's assistant shall not engage in the practice as a physician's assistant except under the terms of a practice agreement

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: "Health professional recovery program" or "program" means a nondisciplinary, treatment-oriented program for impaired health professionals established under section 16167.

minor_patient_chaperone_requirement.quote: a licensee or registrant shall not perform a medical treatment, procedure, or examination on a patient who is a minor that involves the vaginal or anal penetration of the minor unless all of the following are met: ... A medical assistant or another licensee or registrant is in the room while the medical treatment, procedure, or examination is performed.
